Platform Features

Everything You Need for Professional AI Dubbing

A complete suite of AI-powered tools to create authentic, natural-sounding multilingual video content.

Multilingual Dubbing

Seamlessly dub your videos into multiple languages including Urdu, Hindi, Arabic, Spanish, and more.

AI Voice Generation

Generate natural, expressive AI voices that match the emotion and tone of the original speaker.

Intelligent Speech Recognition

Advanced speech-to-text powered by Whisper AI accurately transcribes dialogue across accents and speech patterns.

Key Feature

Segment-Based Editing

Review and edit each individual dialogue segment. Regenerate specific segments without re-processing the entire video.

AI Prompt Editing

Modify dialogue using natural language prompts. Adjust tone, style, and content through simple text instructions.

Emotion & Voice Control

Fine-tune emotion, speaking speed, and voice tone for each segment to achieve the perfect cinematic feel.

Audio Synchronization

Precise audio-video synchronization ensures dubbed audio aligns perfectly with lip movements and scene timing.

High-Quality Video Export

Export your dubbed video in HD quality while preserving background music, sound effects, and original ambiance.

Simple Workflow

From Original Video to Multilingual Content
in Four Simple Steps

Our streamlined workflow makes professional AI dubbing accessible to everyone.

01

Upload Your Video

Upload a video file (MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI up to 2GB) or paste a supported video URL to get started.

  • Supports MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI
  • Up to 2GB file size
  • YouTube & Vimeo URLs supported
02

Select Languages

Choose your video's source language and the target language for dubbing. Currently optimized for Urdu dubbing.

  • Auto-detect source language
  • Multiple target languages
  • Urdu dubbing optimized
03

AI Dubbing

DubFlow AI detects speakers, recognizes speech, translates dialogue, generates voices, and synchronizes audio automatically.

  • Whisper AI transcription
  • Neural machine translation
  • AI voice generation
04

Preview & Export

Review each dubbed segment, make adjustments using AI prompts, and download your completed multilingual video.

  • Segment-by-segment preview
  • AI prompt corrections
  • HD quality export
Key Differentiator

More Than Translation. It's Intelligent Dubbing.

Unlike generic translators that batch-render an entire video blindly, DubFlow AI divides your video into editable dialogue segments, giving you granular creative control.

Segment-Based Editing

Edit individual dialogue segments independently. Regenerate only what needs fixing without re-processing the entire video.

AI Prompt Editing

Write natural language instructions to modify voice style, tone, or phrasing. The AI regenerates audio precisely to your direction.

Speaker-Specific Voices

Assign distinct AI voices to each character in your video for a differentiated, cinematic experience.

Emotion & Tone Control

Fine-tune emotion (serious, angry, calm) and pitch/speed settings to match the actor’s performance.
